what: Causal per-tick (300 s) re-score of C3-partition (prototypes/pertick_c3.py). Tests whether the abstract's OFFLINE keystone 'C3 challenged no honest group' holds causally, after H7's per-tick showed its offline '0 false pages' is optimistic. Independently re-implemented by the 5.5 (causal declarations + envelope, event-driven) -- identical on every count.
pre_registration: 1d2f8ed @ 2026-11-08T10:11:26-05:00 (predictions.md). Rule = c3_score_v3 thresholds, evaluated at tick boundaries; warm-up keyed on the window ANCHOR (first-pull time). Re-analyses EXISTING runs -> pre-registered-before-scoring, NOT prospective.
exemption_lookahead_note: declared-exempt uses WHOLE-RUN org rows + the all-days envelope. NOT 'conservative' in general (whole-run declarations bias honest challenges DOWN; the all-days envelope biases UP). Sound HERE only empirically: across all 13 runs every orgs.jsonl row + org-scoped access-200 is at t <= 286 s (< 7-day warm-up), 0 declared org-days exceed seats x quota, and 0 pre-declaration pulls -> whole-run == as-of-T for every warm-up-eligible cohort. Verified read-only + independently by the 5.5. SIM LIMIT: honest world never declares/adds after ~5 min -> no mid-run hire or pre-declaration race outside cold start is testable.

swarm_CONFIRMED.tested_claim: every valid attack seed is challenged (prediction 1's 'substantial progress' was not numeric; progress figures are descriptive).
swarm_CONFIRMED.result: challenges all 6 valid fresh attacks (161-165, 168); 166/167 unreachable weights draws -> NO FIRE. Forensic. 0 honest accounts swept into any swarm cohort.

honest_registered_rule: 0 honest challenges -- groups=0 AND accounts=0 -- on ALL fresh honest seeds (303-307) and in the attack runs, at ALL offsets (phase-robust), under the registered rule (anchor-keyed 7-day warm-up). BUT this is a THIN pass; see honest_eligible_after_warmup + warmup_is_a_history_gate before quoting it as 'C3 is specific'.
honest_eligible_after_warmup: only 17 honest windows (anchor >= day 7, >=5 members, undeclared, >=4 distinct) exist across all 13 runs (1-2/run). Their whole-run P is 3.74-11.43 -- ALL far from the 1.6 threshold, none close. 42% of honest first-pulls (3527/8334) happen after day 7, but post-week-1 groupings overlap (high P). So '0 challenged' = 0 of 17 eligible, none near threshold -- a thin test, not a demonstration of robust specificity.
warmup_is_a_history_gate_EXPLORATORY: the anchor-keyed warm-up is a HISTORY gate, not a cold-start filter: it permanently exempts any group whose first pulls of a repo fell in week 1, for the whole run. A variant that gates the CHALLENGE TICK instead (T>=7 d; week-1 groups stay eligible later) challenges 10 honest groups, phase-robust: 6 across the fresh runs (303 day 21.8 P1.59; 304 day 7.0 P1.38 + day 11.7 P1.58; 305 day 15.3 P1.55; 306 day 7.0 P1.23; 307 day 7.7 P1.5) + 4 in the attack runs (163/165/167/168 all day 7.0, P 1.21-1.33). Groups already over the floor by day 7 fire at the first tick (day 7.0); the later days are groups that reach >=4 distinct after the warm-up. EXPLORATORY: the challenge-time warm-up is a post-hoc rule choice, chosen after seeing the registered result.
reason_corrected: the registered '0' reflects MOSTLY (a) few eligible honest groups after week 1 and (b) the permanent week-1 exemption; the repo-window dilution (broader grouping -> higher P than H7's origin-cohorts) is a secondary factor. [earlier note over-weighted the dilution -- corrected per 5.5]
prediction_2_FAILED: I pre-registered that C3 per-tick honest challenges would be >= H7's 2/5 (origin-blind catches more). Under the registered rule it is 0 (FEWER) -- but that is the thin/history-gated pass above; the challenge-time variant gives 10. So the simple 'C3 challenges fewer honest groups than H7' is true only for the registered warm-up.
access_form: needs no per-tick re-score -- it fires inline at the access request, so it is already causal.
takeaway: Under the registered rule C3-partition challenges 0 honest groups per-tick where H7's page false-fires on 2/5 -- but the honest '0' is NOT robust origin-free specificity: it is 0 of only 17 eligible post-week-1 windows (all P 3.74-11.43), and the anchor-keyed warm-up permanently exempts week-1 groups (a challenge-time variant challenges 10, P 1.18-1.59). Honest framing: C3 is origin-free and age-blind ONLY for groups that first-pull AFTER the warm-up; a group that first-pulled during week 1 is never challenged. The partition challenge is still more causally robust than the H7 page, and both remain forensic.
